children: Pershing Square Holdings, Ltd. announced a share buyback program of up to $100M, capped at 5,000,000 Public Shares. Jefferies will act as sole buyback agent; repurchased shares will be held in Treasury.
Signals capital return and potential NAV/share accretion; can support share price.
Sets maximum volume; helps gauge potential market impact and daily flow.
Enables purchases during closed periods, smoothing execution.
Shares to be held in Treasury
Reduces free float; provides flexibility for future issuance.
Shows long-term commitment to buybacks; informs credibility of program.

This extends PSH’s long-running capital return strategy, reinforcing a pattern of buybacks since 2017. A larger or accelerated authorization, or evidence of a widening discount-to-NAV narrowing, would be needed to become a bigger catalyst.
